async def list_skills(client: Client) -> List[SkillSummary]:
    """List available skills from the server."""
    # Use the MCP protocol to list skills
    resources = await client.list_resources()
    
    skills = []
    for resource in resources:
        if resource.uri.scheme == "skill" and "/SKILL.md" in resource.uri.path:
            # Extract skill name from URI like "skill://pdf-processing/SKILL.md"
            parts = resource.uri.path.split("/")
            if len(parts) >= 2:
                skill_name = parts[0]
                skills.append(
                    SkillSummary(
                        name=skill_name,
                        uri=str(resource.uri),
                        description=resource.description,
                    )
                )
    
    return skills
